# Gerrit change descriptions show line breaks at fixed-width intervals

## Context / Problem

Reported alongside bug 4e21 (Jira descriptions rendering a break at the end of every soft-wrapped line). The reporter observes a similar-looking line-break problem on Gerrit change descriptions.

## What has already been ruled out

Bug 4e21's fix does NOT address this. That fix changes `text_to_adf` in `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/adf.py`, which lives in the Jira adapter and is reachable only from the Jira REST v3 payload builders (`adapters/jira/acli.py:201`, `adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops.py:369`) plus the three description compare sites. Nothing under `src/rebar/review_bot/` or the Gerrit client imports it. A search of `src/rebar/review_bot/` and `src/rebar/llm/` for `textwrap` or any reflow helper found no matches, so rebar does not appear to be injecting these breaks in code.

## Working hypothesis (NOT yet confirmed — this is the work)

A Gerrit "change description" is the git commit message. Gerrit renders commit messages as preformatted fixed-width text and preserves the author's newlines verbatim. Commit-message bodies are conventionally hard-wrapped at ~72 columns (git's own norm), so the breaks may be authored rather than injected, which would make this intended behavior rather than a defect.

## Acceptance criteria

- Obtain a concrete example Gerrit change whose description renders wrongly, and record the change number.
- Determine whether the newlines are present in the commit message object itself (`git cat-file commit <sha>`) or introduced by a rebar/review-bot code path.
- Classify explicitly: defect vs intended-behavior vs authoring convention. If intended, close as not-a-bug with the citation and, if useful, document the commit-message wrapping convention instead.
- Only if it is a genuine injection defect: fix under RED->GREEN discipline.

## Notes

Filed at the reporter's request during the 4e21 session and deliberately scoped OUT of that session. Not yet reproduced or confirmed as a defect.
data.title: Gerrit change descriptions show fixed-width line breaks (investigate; may be authoring convention)
